Presentation

33½

WEB PROGRAMMING GROUP 2
Robben, Alvin, Carlos, Miftah, William
01 / 09


33½ is a record store for new releases and graded used vinyl.


SELLING THINGS WE
NO LONGER USE

An old jacket. A game you’ve finished.
A book you’ve already read.
Take a photo, describe its condition,
and list it for someone else to buy.
02 / 09


Open with a familiar closet or shelf clearout. Closet photograph: https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/home/organizing/a70159295/why-reverse-hanger-method-works/


33½33½33½
WHAT ABOUT
RECORDS?

Say you find a stack of records while clearing out.
Collectors will ask about the exact copy.
BUYERS
SELLERS
Which pressing is it?
How does it play?
How worn is the sleeve?
What’s my copy worth?
Where can I trade it in?
03 / 09


Collectors ask about the exact pressing and the condition. Crate photograph: https://unsplash.com/photos/person-holding-vinyl-album-MnOPyE-I1RU


OUR
SOLUTION
BUY NEW OR USED
Check separate grades for the record and sleeve.
TRADE IN A RECORD
Request a quote for cash or store credit.
GO CRATE DIGGING
Flip through album covers by genre or artist.
04 / 09


33½ inspects the record and sleeve before resale. Trade-ins refresh the used selection. Crate Digging brings the experience of browsing a record store online.


BUSINESS
MODEL
B2B / RETAIL SOURCING
Buy small batches of new releases from labels
and distributors. Restock based on sales.
B2C / RETAIL & RESALE
Sell new and graded used vinyl to listeners.
Buy used stock for cash or store credit.
05 / 09


Trade-ins bring fresh used stock. Small initial orders and reordering based on actual sales reduce capital tied up in slow sellers.


TARGET USERS
FIRST-TIME BUYERS
Clear grades and an easy
first purchase.
VINYL ENTHUSIASTS
Specific pressings, used finds,
and new releases.
RECORD OWNERS
A quote and a place to
trade in a record.
06 / 09


A customer may move from first-time buyer to collector or seller.


BRAND
IDENTITY
Velvet Volcano
#AB0808
Vienna Roast
#360021
Macabre
#820030
Kurama Orange
#D74D00
Charming Peach
#F1AD7B
Pastry
#F8E1BE
Plum navigation, cream surfaces,
and red accents around the album art.
07 / 09


The six swatches are the supplied Kurama Pastry palette.


FEATURES &
INNOVATION



CRATE DIGGING
Flip through album covers by genre or artist.
USED RECORD DETAILS
Compare separate grades for record and sleeve.
YOUR QUOTES
Send record photos and track trade-in requests.
08 / 09


Cover art via Apple Music, reused from the 33½ prototype. Product details and Your Quotes are two separate flows in the prototype.


FIGMA
PROTOTYPE
Figma link placeholder

09 / 09


Homepage comes from the supplied 33½-6.pdf. Set the button to the published Figma prototype before presenting.
